facts.big: was · were · there was · there were
facts.label: Atraso no passado
facts.sub: Use there was para uma coisa e there were para várias. Use because para o motivo e so para o resultado: I was tired because there was a delay.

facts.label: Havia (um)
facts.sub: Use there was para uma coisa ou para algo que não se conta: There was a delay. There was a lot of wind. A pergunta é Was there food? A resposta curta é Yes, there was.

facts.label: Havia (vários)
facts.sub: Use there were para várias coisas: There were a lot of people. A pergunta é Were there many people? A resposta curta é Yes, there were ou No, there weren’t.

facts.label: Porque
facts.sub: Use because para dar o motivo: The flight was late because there was a lot of wind. Na resposta a Why, comece com because: Because there was a delay.

facts.label: Então
facts.sub: Use so para dar o resultado: We were there for five hours, so I was tired. Because dá o motivo e so dá a consequência. As duas ligam ideias de forma simples.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use was with I, he, she and it.
We use were with you, we and they.

items.why: We say There was a delay.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: We use was with I, he, she and it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We use were with you, we and they. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “There were a delay”. → Falso (We say There was a delay.)
